desc: These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously. Each can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmLion0000000000]{Lion} for up to 1 hour. Once a lion has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
Each Use Lion activity has limited uses which represent the 7 days required before that particular paired figurine can be used again.
name: golden lions
